explanation: Adds compareView.ts (comparePair, landCompareLink, openCompareView, compareLink, sameCompareLink: Compare's default pair, the known-population rule a link lands through, and the link form that leaves defaults out) and useCompareView.ts (the shell's per-dataset hold, whose epoch remounts CompareTab only when a link lands). CompareTab requires defaultPops, drops its macaque e9 / i23 fallback and viewToRecord, opens through openCompareView and reports by value instead of a JSON string round trip.
